desc.doc-parse: Uploaded course materials (docs, slides, audio/video) are parsed into text; audio and video are transcribed automatically.
desc.web-research: Searches the web for supplementary material based on the course request; search queries are rewritten by a lightweight LLM.
desc.outline: Understands the request and materials to produce the course title and per-scene outlines (human-reviewable).
desc.agents: Generates the profiles of teacher and student agents (personas, avatars, voices).
desc.scene-content: Generates slide, quiz, interactive and PBL content per scene — the heaviest LLM stage of the pipeline.
desc.scene-actions: Completes narration and teaching actions for each scene, feeding speech synthesis and classroom play.
desc.tts: Synthesizes narration into teacher/student voices (per scene, serial).
desc.media: Fulfills the image/video placeholders in the generated content, in parallel with the per-scene loop.
desc.interaction: The classroom runtime after generation: multi-agent chat, the PBL runtime and quiz grading.
